performance_profile: Successfully transition the revenue growth motion to an AI-driven sales and merchant onboarding model within the first 6 months.
Scale and upskill a 20-person commercial team to operate at Adoptive AI fluency.
Deliver a minimum of 25% increase in merchant onboarding efficiency using automated AI solutions.
Establish cross-functional alignment with Product to ensure the commercial strategy matches the technology-led transformation.

focus_areas: How they articulate their experience with AI-driven technology transformations.
Their approach to leading teams through significant operational shifts.
Can they genuinely collaborate with Product to redesign the revenue motion?
Do they possess the true 'Adoptive AI fluency' required to lead this charge?
Walking through their career history to validate their track record of scaling teams.
How they have historically handled resistance when rolling out tech-led changes.
Their ability to build a realistic, actionable plan for merchant onboarding using AI.
How they defend their strategic decisions under executive scrutiny.

case_study_options.title: Option A: 90-Day AI Onboarding Rollout
case_study_options.description: Outline an aggressive 90-day plan to integrate AI tools into the existing merchant onboarding process, including team restructuring and KPI adjustments.

case_study_options.title: Option B: Revamping the Sales Motion
case_study_options.description: Design a new AI-driven sales motion for a legacy market, detailing how you would retrain the current account management team to adopt the new workflow.

focus_areas: How they align with Groupon's broader corporate vision and culture.
Their resilience and adaptability in high-pressure executive environments.
